answer: Persistent Work History Lock: each identity's reputation is bound to a slow-to-acquire resource like a nebula of prior task receipts, held escrowed per agent. New clones start at zero, and the first payout is delayed until ten verified jobs complete; minting a clone costs compute and idle time that no cheap attack recovers. Any single pearl of disputed work freezes all linked accounts, so a farming swarm loses shared nectar faster than it can spawn replacements, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
